The '''Brentaal League''' was an ancient colonization organization based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] which oversaw the settling of numerous worlds in the years leading up to the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]].

==History==
The Brentaal League had extended its [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] network to the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] by [[4020 BBY]]. They established the first [[Human/Legends|human]] settlement on [[Muzara]] circa [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], with the intent of starting a lucrative farm industry. In the process, they sparked a diplomatic war with the native [[Muza]]. The League's sphere of influence began to wane soon thereafter.
